A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same RepoMaster study and contain readable main text, figures, tables, equations, and Appendices A–G. The material supports a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original MLE-R and GitTaskBench evaluations, component ablations, and execution case studies, with detailed results in Appendix G.

after.justification: v3 retains these original experiments and appendix results and reports revised GitTaskBench baseline values in Table 2.

M1.justification: Repository search, hierarchical code/dependency mapping, component scoring, context initialization, exploration–execution, and information selection remain unchanged. No algorithmic component is added or revised.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same 22 MLE-R tasks and 54 GitTaskBench tasks spanning 18 repositories. The appendix examples and represented task domains are unchanged.

E2.justification: Tables 1 and 2 retain OpenHands and SWE-Agent under GPT-4o, Claude 3.5, and DeepSeek V3. The revised baseline scores do not change comparator membership.

E3.justification: Sections 4.1–4.2 retain the same task counts, metrics, repository provision, LLM versions, and context settings. No protocol revision is documented to explain the changed Table 2 values.

E4.justification: The component-removal ablations in Table 3 and Figure 4, the 3D pose estimation case study, and the appendix execution logs are retained without substantive changes.

E5.justification: Neither version reports experimental seed counts, repeated-run uncertainty, confidence intervals, or significance tests. The appendix descriptions of retries concern unchanged execution traces.

E6.justification: Table 2 revises completion rates, pass rates, and token counts for all six GitTaskBench baseline configurations. OpenHands/Claude 3.5 changes from 48.15% completion, 24.07% pass, and 3094k tokens to 53.70%, 40.74%, and 2883k, substantially narrowing its reported pass-rate gap to unchanged RepoMaster at 62.96%. MLE-R and ablation results remain unchanged. Appendix Table 5 still contains the earlier baseline values.

T1.justification: The repository and graph definitions, scoring equations (1)–(3), and Appendix F algorithms are mathematically unchanged. No theorem, proof, or formal assumption is added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract narrows the claimed GitTaskBench improvement from 24.1%→62.9% to 40.7%→62.9%. The framework contributions, overall superiority claim, and approximately 95% token-reduction claim remain unchanged.

C2.justification: Explanations involving core-component identification, context efficiency, ablation failure modes, and prospective applications are retained. The revised comparison numbers introduce no substantive reinterpretation or new limitation.

D1.justification: The abstract changes the code and demonstration access location from wanghuacan/RepoMaster to QuantaAlpha/RepoMaster. Implementation settings, prompts, scoring details, and execution logs otherwise remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion and all 55 reference entries are unchanged, preserving the same positioning relative to repository agents and tool-use research.

P1.justification: v3 updates authorship, abbreviates affiliations, and makes small wording and punctuation corrections. Section order and almost all explanatory prose remain unchanged.

P2.justification: v3 adds a front-page bar chart redisplaying Table 1's Claude 3.5 results, resizes and repositions existing figures and tables, and clarifies Table 3's caption. Figure 2 moves from page 5 to page 6; appendix displays are unchanged.

improvement.justification: Limited presentation gains are outweighed by a new inconsistency in a central comparison. In v1, Tables 2 and 5 agree; in v3, Table 2 reports 40.74% pass for OpenHands/Claude 3.5 while Appendix Table 5 retains 24.07%, alongside other conflicting baseline values. No stated setting distinction reconciles them, reducing the clarity and auditability of the empirical evidence.
